detections.evidence_quote: So how do we heal a leaky gut? Figure out what you have too much of or not enough of that is creating the leaks in the first place

detections.evidence_quote: 70% of US homes have some kind of mold issue in them

detections.evidence_quote: 80% of bowel disease. Mold is a piece or the main driver

detections.evidence_quote: a lot of people go right to probiotics
detections.summary: Host introduces probiotics as a common gut fix and criticizes the Activia-era assumption that a probiotic yogurt is enough.

detections.evidence_quote: your gut microbiome is a self-regulating ecosystem
detections.summary: Josh explains the microbiome as a self-regulating ecosystem and dysbiosis as an imbalance.

detections.evidence_quote: the candida overgrowth, these are all normal microbes in our body
detections.summary: Candida overgrowth is described as normal microbes overgrowing opportunistically.

detections.evidence_quote: even a single dose of antibiotics can prevent certain bacteria from ever coming back
detections.summary: Josh cites evidence that a single antibiotic dose can permanently remove gut bacteria.

detections.evidence_quote: I don't think probiotics are really what they're cracked up to be

detections.evidence_quote: 80% of bowel disease. Mold is a piece or the main driver

detections.evidence_quote: if you don't fix the thing that caused the leaky gut in the first place
detections.summary: The speaker contrasts fixing the original cause with treating symptoms.

detections.evidence_quote: It's like, it's not as simple as that
detections.summary: Host pushes back on the simple idea that eating Activia means doing good for your gut.

detections.evidence_quote: if you can fix those, it'll fix itself
detections.summary: The speaker repeatedly directs attention to the underlying dysbiosis cause rather than probiotics as a fix.

detections.evidence_quote: there is plenty of, we'll say ample evidence showing that even a single dose of antibiotics can prevent certain bacteria from ever coming back
